method: Whole2files manual source review and pinned Git byte comparison. No Windows GUI execution.
findings: Extension rows copy logical file bytes/counts from extension records. GetBytesFraction divides copied bytes by rootSize supplied as model physical size, returns0if denominator0 and otherwise has no clamp. This confirms mixed quantity basis noted previously; actual sparse/compressed UI corpus not run.

SetExtensionData deletes/rebuilds rows, optionally aggregates nonempty unregistered extensions, keeps no-extension bucket separate and chooses largest contributing record color. Aggregate disables search/exclusion actions and shell lookup.

OnSearchExtension uses escaped suffix regex and excludes folders; empty extension uses no-dot regex. Thus leading-dot/trailing-dot semantics follow GetExtension implementation rather than platform MIME/type identity.

OnExcludeExtension always appends glob-style star+extension before CompileFilters and full refresh. It does not branch on FilteringUseRegex, so regex-mode compatibility remains a concrete follow-up; no actual GUI/filter invocation in this increment.
Async shell lookup supplies extension rather than physical source path; description remains empty until icon available. Grouping is based on HKCR registration snapshot, not content encoding.
Rows have owned deletion notifications; selected aggregate highlights all unregistered extensions. Selection/focus routing is presentation state, not file equality evidence.
limits: No actual extension percentage, regex-mode exclude, rendering, shell or concurrency runtime test.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
